result.instructions: Tools for Tempika, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which employees are on leave right now?"; "Give me the workday report for October, with overtime totals."; "List the clock-in and clock-out entries of one employee for last week.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Tempika data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run tempika_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run tempika_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run tempika_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. tempika_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: tempika_check_api_key
tools.title: Check API key
tools.description: Check the Tempika API key. Returns its tenant id, its scopes and its requests-per-minute limit. Call this first to see which tools the key can use. Tempika API: GET /api/public/v1/health.

tools.name: tempika_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List the employees of the tenant, without personal data: id, status, company id and external reference. Needs scope employees:read. Pass nextCursor as cursor to get the next page. Tempika API: GET /api/public/v1/employees.

companyId.description: Company id (uuid) of this tenant. Narrows the result to one company.

cursor.description: Employee id from nextCursor of the previous page.

tools.name: tempika_list_time_entries
tools.title: List time entries
tools.description: List clock-in and clock-out entries for a period, without sensitive data: employee id, type, time and source. Needs scope time-entries:read. If truncated is true, use a shorter from/to range, or add companyId or employeeId. Tempika API: GET /api/public/v1/time-entries.

from.description: Start of the period, inclusive (ISO-8601). Default: start of the current month.

to.description: End of the period, exclusive (ISO-8601). Default: now.

companyId.description: Company id (uuid) of this tenant. Narrows the result to one company.

tools.name: tempika_get_workday_report
tools.title: Get workday report
tools.description: Get the aggregated working-time report for a period: entry count, distinct employees, overtime, absence requests and net hours bank. Totals only, no rows and no personal data. Needs scope reports:read. If suppressed is true, the company has too few active employees and the totals are null (privacy threshold). Tempika API: GET /api/public/v1/reports/workday.

from.description: Start of the period, inclusive (ISO-8601). Default: start of the current month.

to.description: End of the period, exclusive (ISO-8601). Default: now.

companyId.description: Company id (uuid) of this tenant. Narrows the result to one company.

prompts.title: Review the workday report for a period
prompts.description: Get the totals for a period: entries, distinct employees, overtime, absence requests and net hours bank. The report has no personal data.

prompts.name: review_clock_in_and_clock_out_entries

prompts.description: List the clock-in and clock-out entries for a period. Filter by company or employee. Use a shorter date range when the result is cut off.

prompts.title: Check which tools an API key can use
prompts.description: Check the tenant, scopes and per-minute request limit of the Tempika API key before you run reports.
